newsitem.title: JAPAN: Rohm 6-mth parent current profit seen up - paper.
newsitem.headline: Rohm 6-mth parent current profit seen up - paper.

text.p: Rohm Co Ltd is expected to post parent current profit of about 21 billion yen in the six months to September 30, 1996, up about 10 percent from a year ago, a Japanese newspaper reported on Thursday.
The company said earlier this year that its half-year current profit would be 22 billion yen, the business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said.
Company spokesmen were not immediately available for comment on the Nihon Keizai report.
The paper said the expectation of higher profit was due to Rohm's cost-cutting and the introduction of new products.
